clips.title: The story
paras: Serpent Wild is a Horde quest in Thousand Needles that connects the discovery of strange alien eggs to ancient tauren legends. Following an unsettling revelation at Freewind Post, Hagar Lightninghoof dispatches adventurers northwest to Motega Firemane at Whitereach Post to confront the awakening of Arikara.

When strange, unnatural eggs began appearing in Thousand Needles, local tauren feared an ecological disaster. However, inspecting the artifacts reveals something far older and more ominous than ordinary predators: signs pointing to the vengeance spirit Arikara. Stunned by the horrifying confirmation, Hagar Lightninghoof realizes the canyon faces a mythical threat long thought relegated to fireside lore.

Recognizing that the threat surpasses simple physical defense, Hagar urges immediate council with Motega Firemane. Stationed northwest along the canyon floor at Whitereach Post, Motega serves as a watcher and spiritual guide versed in the traditional omens of the Needles. His guidance is essential if the Horde hopes to understand and appease or destroy the rising vengeance spirit.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If I did not see that with my own eyes I would never have believed it to be true. Vengeance has come to Thousand Needles!
Friend, you must act quickly! Go now and seek out Motega Firemane; he is located at Whitereach Post just northwest of Freewind Post along the road. He will know what to do!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Vengeance! So, the legend of Arikara is true. Indeed, this is a problem that must be resolved immediately.
